records.text: Candace Owens said internet researchers identified Andrew Kolvet's September 11 appearance on Benny Johnson's show as having been recorded from the Asher Adams hotel in Salt Lake City.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Some members, at least, of the Turning Point USA team stayed at the Asher Adams Autograph Collection Hotel in Salt Lake City. ... here is Andrew Kolvet on Benny Johnson's show on september 11th this is still here that we're showing you and that was all it took i just love the internet Internet sleuths got him and Tyler Bowyer and here's the ash asher adams hotel there it is bang

verification.notes: The September 11 Benny Johnson program transcript confirms that Andrew Kolvet appeared remotely that day. The Asher Adams official gallery supplies comparison imagery, but the accessible evidence does not provide a reliable chain of geolocation, room number, booking record, metadata, or an independent confirmation that Kolvet was broadcasting from that hotel. A visual resemblance asserted by internet researchers is insufficient for a conclusive location determination.
